versions.content: No RTE fan-in support for stand-alone SystemSignal and the same SystemSignal as part of a SystemSignalGroup There is no support by the RTE for a setup where a SystemSignal is received both, via a stand-alone ISignal as well as part of an ISignalGroup , if the DataMapping references the SystemSignalGroup .
